connector.name: Laviya Agent Skills
connector.registryDescription: Laviya AI Orchestration MCP runtime for IDE and agent integrations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package laviya-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kartegagithub account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LAVIYA_API_KEY
env.description: Laviya API key used for MCP runtime authentication.

env.name: LAVIYA_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional base URL override for the Laviya API endpoint.

env.name: LAVIYA_AGENT_UID
env.description: Optional agent UID override for execution orchestration.

env.name: LAVIYA_GLOBAL_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Optional path override for global runtime config (useful in sandboxed environments where home directory is not readable).
